page0.text: I can't do anything about the fact that I forgot. I'll ask her to let it slide.

page1.text:
"Oh, sorry. I ran into someone unexpected today, so I forgot. I'll be careful next time, so would you let this slide?"
I bow in apology.

page2.text:
"...Oh, really? You're going to gloss over this with a few words. I thought you were different from Kiritsugu, but you're really just the same."
"Huh? Illya?"

page3.text:
"Fine. It's more fun for me that way. I'll turn you into my plaything, just like I planned."
"...!?"
I feel a terrible chill.
Illya's eyes give off the same animosity they had the night we first met.

page4.text:
"Bye then, big brother. I'll let you off for today, but you'd better be careful the next time we meet."
She runs away without a second thought.
"Wai—Illya!"

page5.text: I try to folllow her, but I lose sight of her before I can catch up.

page6.text:
"...I wonder if I made her mad."
That was a failure.
I should've apologized to Illya, no doubt about it.

page7.text:
"(Sigh) I'd better think of something before I see her again."
I don't want things to break down between us.
I'll think of a way to cheer her up, and make it up to her for breaking my promise.
